userObservation: Intermittent frozen picture during channel switches, including the same channel sometimes starting normally. Prior confirmed path: TCL Realtek hardware AVC with TextureView.

changes.sourceBoundary: Stop old source, cancel its HTTP, clear media items, apply incoming track preferences, select source-specific codec profile, then set/prepare/play the new source. Same player/session/surface retained. One common path for tune and retry.
changes.codecReuse: Metadata-only id/bitrate changes retain a codec when Media3 reports reuse without reconfiguration; true codec/DRM changes retain the vendor no-flush workaround.
changes.outputGate: For a known-size format in the Android app, delay codec creation until an actual matching Surface is attached. While waiting, renderer is not ready and skipSource returns0, preserving the first keyframe and preventing an early audio clock. The format event still reaches UI. Matching outputs initialize immediately; no timer. The known current format is authoritative for both gate and UI; a stale .secure decoder name cannot hold a new clear HD stream on the wrong view.
changes.configuration: Gate classification and diagnostics share native HDR/DRM rules; animation reads the existing tvnext_animation_v1 preference, with no new setting.
diagnostics: First video frame elapsed time from play request to Media3 rendered-first-frame event
Number of actual video decoder starts for the current tune

regression.sourceAndMetadata: Exact 1.0.21 product code fails four assertions across API28/35: incoming source inherits queued codec, and id/bitrate-only format update requests a codec drain.
regression.outputHandoff: The 1.0.21 renderer, run with the new policy test harness, reaches the controlled adapter factory on the previous output before UI handoff; two expected failures across API28/35.
regression.after: Real Media3 renderer enable/render/format parsing and SampleStream run until the controlled codec factory boundary: no skipped/consumed keyframe or ready video on wrong/missing output; format callback delivered before attach; factory sees exactly the matching Surface. HD/UHD/HDR, startup, and already matching views covered.

limitations: No physical TCL/Ugoos playback validation. Does not prove the driver freeze is absent on the device.
Robolectric uses controlled codec adapters and source streams; surface type flags are modeled and no actual vendor codec/pixel output is tested.
The output gate coordinates known positive dimensions. Unknown-dimension formats retain normal Media3 behavior.
First-frame timing is a Media3 callback timestamp, not a measurement of physical TV pixels.
Original BOX HLS/TS bytes remain inaccessible from this environment. No Windows installer.
